name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le considérant O - Am 92
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Oa. whereas public intervention in housing markets should focus on clearly defined vulnerable groups determined by the Member States and remain targeted and proportionate; whereas subsidised rental schemes that are open-ended or insufficiently targeted risk distorting housing markets; whereas sustainable housing policy should promote access to ownership; whereas public support should complement rather than substitute private investment; whereas effective housing policy must ensure fairness and responsibility, including by addressing non-payment of rent and protecting housing providers; whereas small-scale landlords and family property owners are particularly exposed to financial risks arising from persistent non-payment, legal uncertainty and regulatory burdens;
